s2.ptxt: Turn the cruise control main switch ON.
With the brake pedal depressed, push the cruise control main switch in the +RES direction 3 times within 3 seconds, and check that the buzzer sounds.

atten3.ptxt: Do not turn the headlight dimmer switch ON at this time. Because the automatic beam axis adjustment mode has been started, turning the headlight dimmer switch ON may cause adjustment with incorrect values. If the headlight dimmer switch is turned ON by mistake, perform beam axis adjustment.
